I saved the draft mail to Tobias Rendle and replied to June in her DM thread to confirm it. Nothing has been sent; a person still has to send the draft.

- **The draft:** It's addressed to trendle@pemberline.com with the subject "Tansley 2027 rate". It gives the proposed 2027 per-seat rate of $1,313 a seat for the planning sheet, as Pree gave it, and notes that June approved sharing it.
- **Which mailbox:** Pree originally asked for the draft in her own mailbox. The draft tool can only save to the mailbox of the member I'm acting for, so it's most likely in June's mailbox rather than Pree's. I didn't tell June this in my reply, so it's worth mentioning to her or to Pree.
- **Ilse's request:** I asked June a separate approval question on Oct 15 about Ilse Varga's draft to Tobias, which would put the rate in Ilse's mailbox. June's "as Pree gave it" fits Pree's request, so I took her yes to cover that one only. Ilse's draft still has a placeholder instead of the rate, and I've asked June whether she wants the rate in that one too.
